metadata.meta_home_description: WSGuild creates workshops and tools for digital adventures.
metadata.meta_tutorials_description: Tutorial videos for WSGuild workshops and tools.

hero.hero_desc: We create thoughtful tools and workshops that make digital adventures easier to create, develop, and play with friends.
hero.intro_text: One guild — independent workshops and practical tools for players and creators.

programs.programs_lead: Choose a direction and enter the part of the guild dedicated to it.
programs.program_1_desc: Create your own locations, from a shed to entire kingdoms. Compatible with Guild Tabletop.
programs.program_2_desc: Bring your adventure to life with friends.
programs.program_3_desc: Create and manage your character. Compatible with Guild Tabletop.

callout.callout_title: Create and play your own adventure without unnecessary complexity.
callout.callout_text: Tutorial videos are available for every tool and workshop.

overview.products_intro: Standalone programs created as complete projects to simplify the realization of your boldest ideas.
overview.product_ccl_desc: A dedicated workspace for creating characters. CCL makes the process clear, structured, and convenient to use during play.
overview.product_ccl_feature_2: Important character information in one place
overview.product_ccl_feature_3: A focused interface for long creative sessions

principles.principle_1_desc: Each project solves a clear problem without unnecessary overload.
principles.principle_2_desc: The interface explains itself, and important actions are always close at hand.
principles.principle_3_desc: Projects grow through practical improvements and feedback.

tools.tools_intro: Compact utilities that simplify routine work and keep useful actions close at hand.
tools.tools_catalog_intro: This section is prepared for specialized utilities grouped by purpose.
tools.tool_1_desc: Helpers that remove repetitive steps and keep frequent actions close at hand.
tools.tool_2_desc: Focused spaces for organizing ideas, references, and reusable materials.
tools.tool_3_desc: Simple tools for preparing, checking, and transferring useful information.
tools.tools_note_title: The tool cabinet is being filled
tools.tools_note_text: This page is ready for real tool cards once their names, links, and release statuses are known.

overview.tutorials_intro: A collection of clear video guides for Guild workshops and tools.
overview.tutorials_library_intro: Open a lesson from the list and learn at your own pace.

current_video.tutorials_no_lesson_description: A description of the selected material will appear here.
